notes.en: Built around exact eight-head Vitruvian geometry—navel at the circle centre, groin at the square midpoint, raised fingertips meeting the circle-square intersection, and spread feet resting on the equilateral arc—over a generous gold silhouette with three receding ink-etch tiers and faint metalpoint construction lines so anatomical detail resolves at large scale yet dissolves cleanly by the 38px navbar size without dark striping or fork-like hands. Strict bilateral symmetry forces both standing feet into a foreshortened front turnout rather than Leonardo's contrasted profile foot, and below 24px the standing legs fuse into a single vertical column.
